short_bio: Singer and performer, formerly of Destiny’s Child, with more Grammy Awards than any other artist.
biography:
Beyoncé Knowles was born in Houston, Texas, and came to prominence in the late 1990s as the lead singer of Destiny’s Child. Her first solo album, Dangerously in Love, appeared in 2003.

Lemonade (2016) and Renaissance (2022) were among the most discussed albums of their years, and Cowboy Carter (2024) won the Grammy for Album of the Year in 2025. She holds the record for the most Grammy wins by any artist.

In 2018 she was the first Black woman to headline the Coachella festival; the concert film Homecoming followed in 2019.
